answer: To register, an agent locks a two-asset bond split between token and stablecoin as a slashable bond, turning identity into a financial commitment. Caught selling an identity to a new operator, the fault is proven by key-rotation monitors. Conviction means the challenger who proved the fault keeps the slashed funds. Think of the bond as an orchard: locked, visible, forfeitable. The wharf test is simple: one bond, one identity. A sable deposit keeps honest agents in and priced-out farms out.
